design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark/light personal tech-hub UI. Desktop home shows a clear hero (headline, accent line, stat strip, dual CTAs), coherent card grid, and consistent nav across states. Mobile menu is a clean full-screen drawer with well-spaced targets. Theme toggle produces a complete light theme without layout breakage. Login modal and chat consent gate demonstrate strong interaction affordances (tabs, placeholder labels, disabled-until-consent CTA). Main deductions: floating Voice Agent/chat widgets overlap card content on desktop and mobile, several muted text labels are near low-contrast, and no visible focus/keyboard cues are demonstrated.
strengths: Clear hero hierarchy: kicker badge, large two-tone headline, supporting paragraph, stat strip (47 ARTICLES / 7 RSS / 24/7), and primary+secondary CTAs read in correct order.
Consistent navigation across all desktop states (Feed/Explore/Tools/Challenge/Digest, distinct red 'Break it' pill, settings and Login buttons) with stable logo lockup.
Mobile menu (ui-mobile-menu) is a well-structured drawer with generous tap targets, 'Break it' styled as full-width danger CTA, and an explicit close (X) control.
Theme toggle yields a fully themed light variant: nav, hero, code mockup frame, and cards all re-skinned with no broken or unstyled regions.
Login modal uses clear tabbed Login/Register, labeled Email/Password fields with placeholders, prominent gradient submit button, visible 'Forgot password?' link, and a close icon.
Chat widget gates usage with 'Before we start' disclaimer, terms checkbox, and a visibly disabled 'Agree & Start Chat' button until consent — good interaction clarity and responsible AI messaging.
Card grid uses consistent anatomy (colored icon tile, bold title, muted description, color-coded action link: Explore/Scan/Verify/Check).
issues: Floating Voice Agent / chat widgets overlap page content: on desktop they cover part of the 'Reliability & Fact Check' card text and action link; on mobile they obscure the 'Adversarial Simulation' card.
Low-contrast muted text in several places: stat labels ('ARTICLES TODAY', 'RSS SOURCES', 'AUTO-UPDATED'), card descriptions, and footer hint text may fall below AA contrast on dark background.
No visible focus rings, aria-state, or keyboard affordances demonstrated for nav items, tabs, or the consent checkbox.

Mobile menu screenshot shows the drawer overlapping the page with underlying content (stats, cards) still visible and interactive-looking; no backdrop dimming/scrim evident, which may invite scroll-through.
Login modal close (X) icon is small and low-contrast against the dark header; no escape-hint or field-level validation states are shown.

Stat values differ across screenshots (4 vs 2 vs 47 'ARTICLES TODAY') — dynamic data is fine, but the two dark-mode desktop captures showing different values with identical layout suggests unexplained state, worth verifying.

The dark-mode code mockup shows overlapping/clipped terminal lines ('Running 36 tests on 3 browsers...' partially covered), unlike the cleaner light-theme version — inconsistent mockup rendering between themes.
